Accordion.name: data
Accordion.description: Array of items for Smart Default mode

Accordion.name: defaultOpenId
Accordion.description: ID of the item that should be open by default

Accordion.name: multiple
Accordion.description: If true, allows multiple accordion panels to remain open simultaneously

Alert.name: closable
Alert.description: Determines if the close icon button is rendered

Alert.name: onClose
Alert.description:
Callback fired when the close button is clicked. 
Note: The component is controlled; it does not unmount itself.

Alert.name: asChild
Alert.description: Renders the component using its child element

AvatarGroup.name: max
AvatarGroup.description: Maximum number of avatars to display before truncating

AvatarGroup.name: size
AvatarGroup.description: Size passed down to all nested Avatar components

Badge.name: count
Badge.description: Displays a numerical count inside the badge

Badge.name: max
Badge.description: The maximum number to display before showing a '+' (e.g., 99+)

Badge.name: pill
Badge.description: Rounds the edges to create a pill shape

Badge.name: dot
Badge.description: Renders a small, empty circular indicator instead of text

Badge.name: href
Badge.description: If provided, renders the badge as an <a> tag

Badge.name: onClick
Badge.description: If provided, renders the badge as a <button> tag

Badge.name: asChild
Badge.description: Renders the component using its child element

Breadcrumbs.name: data
Breadcrumbs.description: Array of items for Smart Default mode

Breadcrumbs.name: maxItems
Breadcrumbs.description: The maximum number of items to display before truncating the middle path. Default: 5

Breadcrumbs.name: separator
Breadcrumbs.description: The visual separator between items. Default: '›'

Card.name: clickable
Card.description: If true, makes the card interactive via mouse and keyboard (Enter/Space)

Card.name: hover
Card.description: If true, adds a shadow elevation effect on hover

Chip.name: removable
Chip.description: If true, renders a trailing 'X' button that triggers onRemove

Chip.name: selected
Chip.description: Controls the visual and ARIA active state of the chip

Chip.name: onRemove
Chip.description: Callback fired when the 'X' button is clicked

Chip.name: onSelect
Chip.description: Callback fired when the main body of the chip is clicked or activated via keyboard

ColorPicker.name: value
ColorPicker.description: The currently selected color in hex format

ColorPicker.name: onChange
ColorPicker.description: Callback fired when a color is selected

ColorPicker.name: presets
ColorPicker.description: Array of hex colors to show in the preset grid

ColorPicker.name: showCustom
ColorPicker.description: Whether to show the native color picker input for custom colors

ColorPicker.name: icon
ColorPicker.description: Custom icon to display on the trigger button. Defaults to Palette.

ColorPicker.name: variant
ColorPicker.description: Visual variant for the trigger button. 'default' is a form input, 'icon' is a compact toolbar button.

ColorPicker.name: showText
ColorPicker.description: Show the hex text in the default variant

ColorPicker.name: showSwatch
ColorPicker.description: Show the color swatch circle in the default variant

ColorPicker.name: showIcon
ColorPicker.description: Show the palette icon in the default variant

Combobox.name: onChange
Combobox.description: Callback fired when an option is selected

Combobox.name: emptyMessage
Combobox.description: Message displayed when filtering returns zero results

Combobox.name: filter
Combobox.description: Custom filter function. Defaults to simple substring matching on the label.

Combobox.name: renderOption
Combobox.description: Custom renderer for the entire option row

Combobox.name: renderOptionIcon
Combobox.description: Custom renderer strictly for the option's icon

ContextMenu.name: asChild
ContextMenu.description:
* If true, the ContextMenu will not wrap children in a <div>.
Instead, it clones the child and directly attaches the onContextMenu event.
Child MUST be a valid single React Element.

Drawer.name: open
Drawer.description: Controls the open/closed state of the drawer

Drawer.name: onClose
Drawer.description: Callback fired when the drawer requests to be closed (e.g., Escape key, outside click)

Drawer.name: position
Drawer.description: The edge of the screen the drawer attaches to. Defaults to 'right'

Drawer.name: disableEsc
Drawer.description: Prevents the drawer from closing when the Escape key is pressed

Drawer.name: disableClickOutside
Drawer.description: Prevents the drawer from closing when a click occurs outside the content area

Drawer.name: overlayClassName
Drawer.description: Custom class name applied to the backdrop overlay

Drawer.name: title
Drawer.description: Optional title displayed at the top of the Drawer

Drawer.name: description
Drawer.description: Optional description displayed below the title

Drawer.name: hideCloseButton
Drawer.description: If true, hides the default close 'X' button

Drawer.name: transitionDuration
Drawer.description: Transition duration in seconds. Defaults to 0.3

EmptyState.name: icon
EmptyState.description: The icon or illustration to display at the top of the empty state.

EmptyState.name: title
EmptyState.description: The main title describing the empty state.

EmptyState.name: description
EmptyState.description: The descriptive text explaining what is missing or how to resolve it.

EmptyState.name: actions
EmptyState.description: Call to action buttons or links.

FileUploader.name: value
FileUploader.description: Controlled state for the selected files

FileUploader.name: defaultValue
FileUploader.description: Uncontrolled initial state for the selected files

FileUploader.name: onChange
FileUploader.description: Callback fired when the list of selected files changes

FileUploader.name: multiple
FileUploader.description: Whether to allow multiple files to be selected. Defaults to false.

FileUploader.name: accept
FileUploader.description: A comma-separated list of allowed file extensions or MIME types (e.g., '.jpg, .png, application/pdf')

FileUploader.name: maxSize
FileUploader.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes

FileUploader.name: className
FileUploader.description: Custom class name applied to the root container

FileUploader.name: placeholder
FileUploader.description: Custom text or element displayed inside the dropzone (Primary Title)

FileUploader.name: description
FileUploader.description: Secondary text or description below the placeholder

FileUploader.name: disabled
FileUploader.description: Disables the dropzone and prevents file selection

HoverCard.name: openDelay
HoverCard.description: Delay in milliseconds before the card opens. Defaults to 200ms.

HoverCard.name: closeDelay
HoverCard.description: Delay in milliseconds before the card closes. Defaults to 300ms.

HoverCard.Content.name: placement
HoverCard.Content.description: Preferred placement of the card relative to the trigger. Defaults to 'bottom'

HoverCard.Content.name: offset
HoverCard.Content.description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and the card. Defaults to 8px.

HoverCard.Content.name: hideArrow
HoverCard.Content.description: If true, hides the directional arrow pointing to the trigger.

Container.name: size
Container.description: The maximum width bounds for the container. Defaults to 'lg'.

Container.name: asChild
Container.description: Merges props into the immediate child when true, allowing polymorphic rendering

Flex.name: align
Flex.description: Defines the align-items cross-axis behavior. Defaults to 'stretch'.

Flex.name: justify
Flex.description: Defines the justify-content main-axis behavior. Defaults to 'start'.

Flex.name: wrap
Flex.description: Defines the flex-wrap behavior. Defaults to 'nowrap'.

Flex.name: gap
Flex.description: The gap between flex items. Accepts numbers (px) or valid CSS strings. Defaults to 0.

Stack.name: align
Stack.description: Defines the align-items cross-axis behavior. Defaults to 'stretch'.

Stack.name: wrap
Stack.description: Defines the flex-wrap behavior. Defaults to 'nowrap'.

Stack.name: justify
Stack.description: Defines the justify-content main-axis behavior. Defaults to 'start'.

Stack.name: gap
Stack.description: The gap between flex items. Accepts numbers (px) or valid CSS strings. Defaults to 0.

HStack.name: align
HStack.description: Defines the align-items cross-axis behavior. Defaults to 'stretch'.

HStack.name: wrap
HStack.description: Defines the flex-wrap behavior. Defaults to 'nowrap'.

HStack.name: justify
HStack.description: Defines the justify-content main-axis behavior. Defaults to 'start'.

HStack.name: gap
HStack.description: The gap between flex items. Accepts numbers (px) or valid CSS strings. Defaults to 0.

Grid.name: columns
Grid.description: Number of fixed columns, or responsive auto algorithms. Defaults to 'auto-fit'.

Grid.name: gap
Grid.description: The gap between grid items. Accepts numbers (px) or valid CSS strings. Defaults to 16.

Grid.name: minColWidth
Grid.description: The minimum width a column can shrink to before wrapping. Used with auto-fit/fill. Defaults to '250px'.

Link.name: isExternal
Link.description: Automatically applies `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for external routing security.

Link.name: asChild
Link.description:
* Polymorphic Prop: When true, delegates rendering to its child.
Crucial for integrating with framework routers like Next.js `<Link>` or React Router.

Modal.name: hideCloseButton
Modal.description: Hides the 'X' close button in the top right corner.

MultiSelect.name: defaultValue
MultiSelect.description: Uncontrolled initial state for selected values

MultiSelect.name: onChange
MultiSelect.description: Callback fired when the selection changes

MultiSelect.name: placeholder
MultiSelect.description: Text displayed when no options are selected

MultiSelect.name: name
MultiSelect.description: Name attribute applied to hidden inputs for native form submission

MultiSelect.name: maxTags
MultiSelect.description: Number of tags to render before collapsing into a summary string (e.g., "3 selected")

NUIProvider.name: defaultTheme
NUIProvider.description: The default theme if nothing is in local storage. Defaults to 'system'.

NUIProvider.name: storageKey
NUIProvider.description: The local storage key used to persist the theme preference. Defaults to 'nui-theme'.

Pagination.name: total
Pagination.description: The total number of pages available

Pagination.name: onChange
Pagination.description: Callback fired when a new page is selected

Pagination.name: siblings
Pagination.description: Number of page links to show on each side of the current page. Defaults to 1.

Pagination.name: className
Pagination.description: Custom class name applied to the root navigation element

Pagination.name: disabled
Pagination.description: Disables all interaction with the pagination controls

Popover.Content.name: placement
Popover.Content.description: Preferred placement of the popover relative to the trigger. Defaults to 'bottom'

Popover.Content.name: offset
Popover.Content.description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and the popover. Defaults to 8px.

Popover.Content.name: showArrow
Popover.Content.description: Whether to show a directional arrow pointing to the trigger. Defaults to false for modern aesthetic.

Progress.name: max
Progress.description: The maximum possible value. Defaults to 100.

Progress.name: indeterminate
Progress.description: Forces the progress bar into an animated indeterminate state

Progress.name: size
Progress.description: The visual height of the progress bar. Defaults to 'md'.

Progress.name: variant
Progress.description: The semantic color variant. Defaults to 'default'.

Progress.name: label
Progress.description: WAI-ARIA hidden label for screen readers. Defaults to 'Progress'.

Rating.name: max
Rating.description: The maximum possible rating. Determines how many icons to render. Defaults to 5.

Rating.name: onChange
Rating.description: Callback fired when a rating is selected

Rating.name: icon
Rating.description: Custom React node for the empty state
Rating.defaultValue:
(
 <svg width="1em" height="1em" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">

 </svg>
)

Rating.name: iconFilled
Rating.description: Custom React node for the filled state

 </svg>
)

Rating.name: disabled
Rating.description: Disables interactions and applies a muted style

Resizable.name: direction
Resizable.description: The flex layout direction. Defaults to 'horizontal'.

Resizable.name: onLayout
Resizable.description: Callback fired when the user completes a resize action, providing an array of panel sizes (percentages)

Select.name: onChange
Select.description: Callback fired when an option is selected

Select.name: placeholder
Select.description: Text displayed when no option is selected

Select.name: name
Select.description: Name attribute applied to the hidden input for native form submission

Select.name: error
Select.description: Applies error styling to the trigger button

Skeleton.name: size
Skeleton.description: The predefined height mapping for the skeleton

Skeleton.name: width
Skeleton.description: Explicit width override (supports numbers as px, or strings like '100%')

Skeleton.name: height
Skeleton.description: Explicit height override (supports numbers as px, or strings like '50px')

Skeleton.name: animated
Skeleton.description: Enables or disables the sweeping shimmer animation. Defaults to true.

Skeleton.name: circle
Skeleton.description: Forces the skeleton into a perfect circle, ignoring the size height

Skeleton.name: ariaHidden
Skeleton.description: Hides the element from screen readers. Defaults to true (recommended).

Slider.name: min
Slider.description: The minimum allowed value. Defaults to 0.

Slider.name: max
Slider.description: The maximum allowed value. Defaults to 100.

Slider.name: step
Slider.description: The interval between valid values. Defaults to 1.

Slider.name: value
Slider.description: The controlled value of the slider.

Slider.name: defaultValue
Slider.description: The initial uncontrolled value of the slider.

Slider.name: onChange
Slider.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

Slider.name: disabled
Slider.description: Disables the slider and prevents interaction.

Spinner.name: size
Spinner.description: The predefined size of the spinner. Defaults to 'md'.

Spinner.name: variant
Spinner.description: The color theme variant. Defaults to 'primary'.

Spinner.name: label
Spinner.description: WAI-ARIA label read by screen readers. Defaults to 'Loading...'.

Stepper.name: data
Stepper.description: Array of steps. Can be simple strings or rich objects.

Stepper.name: active
Stepper.description: The 0-based index of the currently active step.

Stepper.name: onChange
Stepper.description: Callback fired when a step is clicked.

Stepper.name: disableFuture
Stepper.description: Prevents the user from clicking on steps that come after the currently active one.

Table.name: data
Table.description: Array of data objects to render

Table.name: rowKey
Table.description: A unique identifier for each row (string/number key, or a function that returns a string)

Table.name: emptyText
Table.description: Text or React Node to display when the data array is empty

Tabs.name: value
Tabs.description: Controlled state value representing the active tab

Tabs.name: onChange
Tabs.description: Callback fired when the active tab changes

Tabs.name: data
Tabs.description: Data array for Smart Mode mapping

Timeline.name: data
Timeline.description: Array of items for Smart Default mode

Timeline.name: hideLine
Timeline.description: If true, hides the connecting lines between all nodes

TimePicker.name: value
TimePicker.description: Standard HTML5 time format: HH:mm (24-hour format internally)

TimePicker.name: onChange
TimePicker.description: Callback fired when a time segment is selected

TimePicker.name: minuteStep
TimePicker.description: Step interval for the minute column. Defaults to 1.

TimePicker.name: name
TimePicker.description: Name attribute for the hidden input (for native forms)

TimeRangePicker.name: onChange
TimeRangePicker.description: Callback fired when either the start or end time changes

TimeRangePicker.name: clockType
TimeRangePicker.description: Uses 12-hour or 24-hour clock formatting. Defaults to 12.

TimeRangePicker.name: minuteStep
TimeRangePicker.description: Step interval for the minute column. Defaults to 1.

TimeRangePicker.name: placeholder
TimeRangePicker.description: Placeholder text displayed when no range is selected

TimeRangePicker.name: nameFrom
TimeRangePicker.description: Name attribute applied to the "from" hidden input for native forms

TimeRangePicker.name: nameTo
TimeRangePicker.description: Name attribute applied to the "to" hidden input for native forms

Tooltip.name: label
Tooltip.description: The text or content displayed inside the tooltip

Tooltip.name: children
Tooltip.description: The trigger element. Must be a single valid React Element (like a button)

Tooltip.name: className
Tooltip.description: Additional CSS classes for the tooltip container

Tooltip.name: delay
Tooltip.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing the tooltip on hover/focus. Defaults to 200.

Tooltip.name: offset
Tooltip.description: Distance in pixels between the tooltip and the trigger. Defaults to 8.

VirtualList.name: items
VirtualList.description: Array of data items to render

VirtualList.name: height
VirtualList.description: Height of the scrollable viewport in pixels. If omitted, it will automatically size to its container.

VirtualList.name: itemHeight
VirtualList.description: Fixed height for each row in pixels. Defaults to 40.

VirtualList.name: overscan
VirtualList.description: Extra rows to render above and below the viewport to prevent white flashes during fast scrolling

VirtualList.name: keyExtractor
VirtualList.description: Extracts a unique React key for each item. Crucial for stable rendering during sorts/filters!

VirtualList.name: renderItem
VirtualList.description: The render function for the row

Watermark.name: text
Watermark.description: The text to display. Can be an array for multi-line watermarks.
